en.title: Wash the dishes
en.description: Wash and rinse what's in the sink, then leave it to dry.

en.title: Load the dishwasher
en.description: Stack the dirty dishes, add a tablet and start it.

en.title: Unload the dishwasher
en.description: Put the clean dishes back in the cupboards.

en.title: Cook dinner
en.description: Plan and cook dinner for the house.

en.title: Make breakfast
en.description: Set the breakfast table and brew the tea or coffee.

en.title: Wipe the counters
en.description: Wipe the counters, the table and the hob.

en.title: Clean the stove and oven
en.description: Remove grease and burnt spots, wash the racks.

en.title: Tidy the fridge
en.description: Toss what's expired, wipe the shelves, reorganise.

en.title: Clean the microwave
en.description: Wipe the inside and the turntable.

en.title: Scrub the shower and tub
en.description: Remove limescale and soap marks, wipe the glass.

en.title: Clean the drains
en.description: Clear hair and clogs, use drain cleaner.

en.title: Clean the sink and taps
en.description: Scrub the basin and descale the taps.

en.title: Clean the mirrors
en.description: Wipe water and toothpaste spots off the mirrors.

en.title: Swap the towels
en.description: Put used towels in the wash and hang fresh ones.

en.title: Mop the bathroom floor
en.description: Mop the floor, corners included.

en.title: Sort the bathroom cabinet
en.description: Toss empties and note what's running out.

en.title: Run a load of laundry
en.description: Sort colours from whites and start the machine.

en.title: Hang the laundry
en.description: Hang the washing to dry once the cycle ends.

en.title: Fold the dry laundry
en.description: Fold the dry clothes and drop them in each room.

en.title: Do the ironing
en.description: Iron shirts and anything creased.

en.title: Clean the dryer filter
en.description: Empty the lint filter and water tank.

en.title: Clean the toilet
en.description: Brush the bowl, disinfect the lid and seat.

en.title: Clean the toilet sink
en.description: Wipe the basin and tap.

en.title: Restock toilet paper
en.description: Replace the roll and check the spares.

en.title: Empty the toilet bin
en.description: Empty the bin and put in a new bag.

en.title: Disinfect the floor
en.description: Mop the floor, around the toilet too.

en.title: Swap the hand towel
en.description: Hang a fresh hand towel.

en.title: Make the beds
en.description: Straighten the duvet and plump the pillows.

en.title: Change the bed sheets
en.description: Change sheets and covers, put the old ones in the wash.

en.title: Tidy the room
en.description: Put away whatever is lying around.

en.title: Tidy the living room
en.description: Straighten the sofa, clear the coffee table, fix the cushions.

en.title: Dust the surfaces
en.description: Dust shelves, tables and the TV unit.

en.title: Clean the windows
en.description: Wipe the inside of the windows and the sills.

en.title: Organise the wardrobe
en.description: Fold clothes and set aside off-season ones.

en.title: Check lamps and sockets
en.description: Replace dead bulbs, tidy the cables.

en.title: Vacuum the floors
en.description: Vacuum every room and the rugs.

en.title: Mop the floors
en.description: Mop the floors after vacuuming.

en.title: Shake out the rugs
en.description: Shake out the doormat and small rugs outside.

en.title: Disinfect door handles
en.description: Wipe handles, switches and remotes.

en.title: Tidy the entryway
en.description: Put shoes away and hang the coats.

en.title: Deep clean
en.description: A thorough clean of the whole house.

en.title: Feed the pet
en.description: Fill the food bowl and check the portion.

en.title: Feed the dog
en.description: Give the morning and evening meal.

en.title: Feed the cat
en.description: Serve the food and refresh the water.

en.title: Walk the dog
en.description: A walk of at least 30 minutes.

en.title: Clean the litter box
en.description: Scoop the litter, replace it fully when needed.

en.title: Refresh the water bowl
en.description: Rinse the bowl and pour fresh water.

en.title: Brush the pet
en.description: Brush the coat and check the claws.

en.title: Clean the tank or cage
en.description: Change the water or the cage bedding.

en.title: Take out the trash
en.description: Gather every bin bag and take it down.

en.title: Sort the recycling
en.description: Split plastic, paper and glass into their boxes.

en.title: Wash the bins
en.description: Wash the bins and get rid of the smell.

en.title: Drop off batteries and glass
en.description: Take spent batteries and glass to the drop-off point.

en.title: Water the plants
en.description: Check the pots and water the dry ones.

en.title: Sweep the balcony
en.description: Sweep the balcony and wipe the table and chairs.

en.title: Tend the pots
en.description: Remove dead leaves and add fertiliser.

en.title: Tidy the garden
en.description: Mow the lawn and rake the leaves.

en.title: Do the grocery run
en.description: Check the shared list and buy what's missing.

en.title: Buy bread and milk
en.description: Pick up the daily bread and milk.

en.title: Restock cleaning supplies
en.description: Check detergent, sponges and bin bags.

en.title: Pay the bills
en.description: Pay electricity, water, gas and internet.

en.title: Plan the weekly menu
en.description: Pick the week's meals and write the list.
